stage_objective: 把 WebGPT-as-Codex 做成真正的一仓库、一站式、discovery-first 的 MCP/依赖安装升级系统：检测已有部署与实际版本，健康且兼容则保留，缺失则按官方来源安装，旧版本受控升级，已更新版本不得降级；默认追踪最新 stable 但必须经过来源和兼容性 Gate；不依赖 Coding Tools 自带的 Cloudflare 公网链路；不重复部署已有 MCP。
required_outputs: component installation/version metadata schema and source adapters
latest-stable upstream discovery with compatibility gate
fresh-machine system dependency detection including Node/npm/uv/Git where selected components require them

install/upgrade adapters for Serena, Coding Tools, Playwright MCP, Windows-MCP, Tailscale and WebGPT-owned runtime dependencies, while Remote Desktop Commander stays the explicit ChatGPT-side manual integration boundary
duplicate deployment prevention based on live listener/protocol/install evidence rather than PATH absence
lifecycle authority only for instances installed/owned by WebGPT
tests plus live non-destructive existing-machine evidence
updated SoT/risks/experience/closure and a verified recursive Playwright handoff to Stage 16
do_not_redo: Stages 1-14 unless contradictory evidence requires reopening the minimum affected boundary
do not redesign the production Gateway/OAuth/Tailscale Edge that Stage 14 already verified
do not switch or activate the shared Serena instance during this stage because the user is using Serena for another task; use Coding Tools for code navigation/search in this stage
do not modify or replace existing healthy MCP public endpoints merely to make them WebGPT-managed
do not touch the Stage 17/18 WIP files listed in the prompt unless a Stage 15 correctness dependency is proven
do not vendor entire third-party source repositories into WebGPT-as-Codex
known_risks: PATH/package absence is not proof an MCP is absent; the machine can already have a healthy service deployed by another mechanism.
Blind latest installs can break compatibility; latest stable is a candidate that must pass source/provenance and compatibility checks.
Coding Tools has an optional Cloudflare remote path, but WebGPT's supported unified design needs only its localhost MCP backend.
Existing healthy services and current public tunnels are active user infrastructure and must be preserved.
The current working tree intentionally contains later-stage WIP that must not be mixed into the Stage 15 commit.
Serena's shared process-wide active project can conflict across conversations, so Stage 15 must not use project switching; Stage 16 owns isolation.
